searchText: Are the precompiles for BLS_12_381 operations scheduled to go on Mainnet? It's not yet scheduled, but it's been considered for inclusion into Shanghai fork that is planned after the Merge. A bit of discussion around this was at the end of this call https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/449
